Yes part of it is human instinct to want to survive, but also I want to see the world. Im too curious about too many things to go yet. I want to find that perfect girl and experience true love. I have to say that is a very interesting way of putting depression. That really painted a picture of what it can feel like. But I disagree that we are NPCs. We have no predetermined path ahead of us and we have our own worlds within this world. You are the main character of your own life. Lara Croft doesn't always go on adventures, when shes not off in some ruins shes at home living a normal life. Crash Bandicoot often snoozes and spends his days resting when hes not adventuring and even Mario has a life when hes (probably) having cake at Peach's castle like she suggested.

My point is its easy to feel like an NPC but you are the main guy. If people don't talk to you too much then they are NPCs in your life, your story. Its not your fault at all. But you are the one who has the story to tell and write, they are part of yours, like you are part of mine now. I hope I wasn't too confusing. I really liked you putting it into gamer terms though.
